snippet.title: A Chicken vs An Alien Army!? — CAWCAKNIGHT Gameplay Demo Trailer | SAGE 2026
snippet.description:
A CHICKEN is our last hope against an alien invasion!? 🐔⚔️

Watch CAWCAKNIGHT in action: beak-hook grapples to fly across levels, feather-sword combat that hits in any direction, and boss fights built to test your unexpected skills!

The DEMO is playable RIGHT NOW at SAGE 2026 — come try it in person, or wishlist on Steam (when our page is up!) and get ready to peck your way through an alien army.

CAWCAKNIGHT is a 2D-platformer where you perform tricks and stunts that only a bird could pull off to peck away at an alien army set on world domination!

In this love-letter to 90's classics, you can run expressively, perform fast-paced movements and fast attacks to get through the levels! Use your Feather Sword to defeat hordes of enemies and save your barn, your flock and the world from a cruel end, filled with weird aliens that dominated the planet with the strengths of a weird rubber-like material and other goofy shenanigans!

🎮  Play the demo: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/cawcaknight-sage-2026-demo.3174/
🔗 Follow us for updates:
📷: https://www.instagram.com/vybrantcrewdev/
